tasks.name: Design Problem Library UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for browsing and searching problems in the library.

tasks.name: Implement Problem Library Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend to store and retrieve problems for the library.

tasks.name: Set Up Problem Library Database
tasks.description: Design and implement the database schema for storing problem details.

tasks.name: Develop Code Editor UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for the code editor where users can write and test code.

tasks.name: Integrate Code Execution Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend service to execute user-submitted code and return results.

tasks.name: Set Up Code Execution Environment
tasks.description: Configure the environment to securely execute user-submitted code.

tasks.name: Create Online Judge Logic
tasks.description: Develop the logic to evaluate user submissions against test cases.

tasks.name: Design User Profiles UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for user profiles, including stats and achievements.

tasks.name: Implement User Profiles Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend to manage user data, stats, and achievements.

tasks.name: Set Up User Profiles Database
tasks.description: Design and implement the database schema for storing user profile data.

tasks.name: Develop Leaderboard UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for displaying user rankings and scores.

tasks.name: Implement Leaderboard Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend to calculate and retrieve leaderboard rankings.

tasks.name: Set Up Leaderboard Database
tasks.description: Design and implement the database schema for storing leaderboard data.

tasks.name: Create Tutorials and Hints UI
tasks.description: Design the frontend interface for accessing tutorials and hints for problems.

tasks.name: Implement Tutorials and Hints Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend to manage and serve tutorials and hints.

tasks.name: Set Up Tutorials and Hints Database
tasks.description: Design and implement the database schema for storing tutorials and hints.

tasks.name: Perform Frontend Testing
tasks.description: Test all frontend components for usability and responsiveness.

tasks.name: Perform Backend Testing
tasks.description: Test all backend services for functionality and performance.

tasks.name: Perform Database Testing
tasks.description: Test all database schemas and queries for correctness and efficiency.

tasks.name: Deploy Application
tasks.description: Deploy the complete application to a production environment.

T1.implementation_approach: Design a user-friendly interface with search, filter, and categorization options for problems.
T1.notes: Ensure responsive design for various devices.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful APIs to handle problem data retrieval, creation, and updates.

T3.implementation_approach: Set up a relational database schema to store problem details, tags, and metadata.

T4.implementation_approach: Design an intuitive code editor with syntax highlighting, auto-completion, and error detection.
T4.notes: Consider integrating popular libraries like Monaco Editor.

T5.implementation_approach: Develop APIs to send code to the backend for execution and return results.
T5.notes: Ensure proper handling of timeouts and errors.

T6.implementation_approach: Set up a secure containerized environment for code execution using tools like Docker.
T6.notes: Implement resource limits to prevent abuse.

T7.implementation_approach: Create logic to evaluate code submissions against test cases and provide feedback.
T7.notes: Include support for multiple programming languages.

T8.implementation_approach: Design a profile UI to display user details, achievements, and activity history.
T8.notes: Ensure easy navigation and personalization options.

T9.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to manage user data, authentication, and profile updates.

T10.implementation_approach: Set up a database schema to store user profiles, preferences, and activity logs.

T11.implementation_approach: Design a leaderboard UI to display rankings based on user performance metrics.
T11.notes: Include filters for different categories and timeframes.

T12.implementation_approach: Develop backend logic to calculate and update leaderboard rankings dynamically.

T13.implementation_approach: Set up a database schema to store leaderboard data and ranking history.
T13.notes: Ensure efficient querying for large datasets.

T14.implementation_approach: Design a tutorials and hints UI with easy navigation and multimedia support.
T14.notes: Focus on accessibility and user engagement.

T15.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to manage tutorial content and hint retrieval.
T15.notes: Allow for dynamic updates and versioning.

T16.implementation_approach: Set up a database schema to store tutorials, hints, and related metadata.
T16.notes: Ensure scalability for future content additions.

T17.implementation_approach: Perform UI/UX testing to ensure responsiveness, functionality, and user satisfaction.
T17.notes: Use tools like Selenium or manual testing.

T18.implementation_approach: Test backend APIs for performance, security, and correctness using tools like Postman or JMeter.

T19.implementation_approach: Validate database schema, queries, and data integrity through automated and manual tests.
T19.notes: Focus on stress testing for large datasets.

T20.implementation_approach: Deploy the application using cloud services like AWS or Azure with CI/CD pipelines.
T20.notes: Ensure proper monitoring and rollback mechanisms.
